camel_example: aliyun ecs DescribeLaunchTemplates --region cn-hangzhou --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 1 --TemplateTag.1.Value TestValue --TemplateTag.1.Key TestKey --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --LaunchTemplateId.1 'lt-m5e3ofjr1zn1aw7q0000' --LaunchTemplateName.1 'wd-1526307480000' --TemplateResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmxazb4p0000'
description_en: Calls the DescribeLaunchTemplates operation to query information about one or more launch templates. You can specify parameters such as TemplateTag, TemplateResourceGroupId, and LaunchTemplateId. The returned information includes the total number of launch templates, template creation time, and latest template version number
description_zh: 调用DescribeLaunchTemplates接口，并可以指定TemplateTag、TemplateResourceGroupId、LaunchTemplateId等参数，查询一个或多个实例启动模板的信息，例如启动模板总个数、模板创建时间、模板最新版本号等信息集合
kebab_example: aliyun ecs describe-launch-templates --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --template-tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --template-resource-group-id rg-acfmxazb4p0000 --launch-template-id lt-m5e3ofjr1zn1aw7q0000 --launch-template-name wd-1526307480000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeLaunchTemplates

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
parameters.name: region_id

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the launch template. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

If you use a single tag to filter resources, the resource count with the specified tag cannot exceed 1000. If you use multiple tags to filter resources, the resource count of resources that have all specified tags attached cannot exceed 1000. If the resource count exceeds 1000, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/110425.html operation to query resources
fields.help_zh:
启动模板的标签键。N的取值范围：1~20。

使用一个标签过滤资源，查询到该标签下的资源数量不能超过1000个；使用多个标签过滤资源，查询到同时绑定了多个标签的资源数量不能超过1000个。如果资源数量超过1000个，请使用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/110425.html接口进行查询
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value of the launch template. Valid values of N: 1 to 20
fields.help_zh: 启动模板的标签值。N的取值范围：1~20
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The list of tag key-value pairs of the launch template itself.
Currently, you can create and query tags of launch templates only by calling API operations. You cannot create or view tags in the console
parameters.help_zh:
启动模版自身的标签对信息列表。
当前仅支持通过API创建和查询启动模板的标签，控制台无法创建或查看
parameters.name: template_tag

parameters.help_en:
The page number of the launch template list. Minimum value: 1.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
实例启动模板列表的页码。起始值：1。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page for a paged query.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数。

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the launch template belongs. When you use this parameter to filter resources, the resource count cannot exceed 1000.

Filtering by the default resource group is not supported
parameters.help_zh:
启动模板所在的企业资源组ID。使用该参数过滤资源时，资源数量不能超过1000个。

不支持默认资源组过滤
parameters.name: template_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of one or more launch templates.

You can query up to 100 launch templates at a time.

You must specify LaunchTemplateId or LaunchTemplateName to determine the template
parameters.help_zh:
一个或多个实例启动模板ID数组。

最多支持查询100个启动模板。

您必须指定LaunchTemplateId或LaunchTemplateName以确定模板
parameters.name: launch_template_id

parameters.help_en:
The names of one or more launch templates.

You can query up to 100 launch templates at a time.

You must specify LaunchTemplateId or LaunchTemplateName to determine the template
parameters.help_zh:
一个或多个实例启动模板名称数组。

最多支持查询100个启动模板。

您必须指定LaunchTemplateId或LaunchTemplateName以确定模板
parameters.name: launch_template_name

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page set for the paged query. This is the paging settings value
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of launch templates
